overview_description.description:
Bud Financial (“Bud”) enriches financial data, identifying the likes of merchant, category, location and regularity of transactions, to provide actionable insights and readable inputs for LLMs in the financial services industry.

Scaling rapidly, Bud has been a trailblazer in its use of AI since 2015. The company has enabled banks and fintechs worldwide to get customer context from their transaction data so they can personalize the banking experience, proactively manage risk and optimize their business operations.

With tens of billions of transactions processed, Bud’s market-leading transactional enrichment, categorization and analysis helps financial institutions to become intelligent enterprises, fully harnessing their customer data and finding new, data-driven opportunities to grow.

product.name: Enrich
product.description: A transaction-data enrichment service that converts raw financial data into structured information about merchants, categories, locations, recurrence and other transaction attributes.

product.name: Drive
product.description: An analytics and segmentation product that helps financial institutions analyze customer transaction data, explore segments and deliver targeted actions.

product.name: Engage
product.description: A financial management and personalization product that uses transaction insights to provide tailored money-management tools and customer interactions.

product.name: Assess
product.description: A lending and credit-risk solution that uses financial data to evaluate affordability, creditworthiness and suitability throughout the lending lifecycle.

product.name: Focus
product.description: A customer intelligence dashboard that gives frontline financial-services staff a consolidated view of customer insights, needs and risk indicators.
